column1: # vesmaro-node compatibility ledger — known-good (core, mesh) pairs.
#   core_tag      git tag in the vesmaro repo (server venv is built from it)
#   mesh_ref      git tag OR commit sha in the mnemos-mesh repo
#   mesh_version  what `mnemos-mesh version` must print for that ref
#   verified      how the pair was verified (live-laptop | staging | ...)
# vesmaro-node resolves the DEFAULT install/upgrade pair from the LAST
# data row of this file. An unknown (core, mesh) combination makes
# `upgrade` refuse with a hint (add a row or --force).
# Seeded with the live laptop pair (2026-09-22). NOTE: the vesmaro
# pyproject still says 4.3.0 under tag v4.3.7-mesh.2 — the LEDGER is
# tag-based (core_tag is the identity); the binary version string is
# informational only (see status output for both).
